We applied template 1914389 to the target molecule (the SMILES from make_5_lvl1-apply_template-1 first entry?). The result is a tuple containing one pair of precursors: ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC').

But the input from make_5_lvl1-apply_template-1 gave three possible SMILES (maybe different protecting group placements). We need to apply the template to each of those? The task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl1-template_search-2 to the molecule below". The molecule below likely is the one from make_5_lvl1-apply_template-1? Actually that input gave three SMILES options (maybe stereoisomers). We need to apply the template to each of those three molecules and collect all possible precursor combinations.

Thus we need to apply template 1914389 to each of the three SMILES strings.

Let's extract them:

List from make_5_lvl1-apply_template-1 answer: 
[
 ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"],
 ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"],
 ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"]
]

So three SMILES.

We need to apply template to each. Use apply_template tool for each.
